lines.2: The weather was clear. It was eleven in the morning.
lines.3: Well, another peaceful day was about to beg--
lines.9: 「As agreed, I will be living here starting today.」
lines.12: 「--That witless expression tells me you just woke up.」
lines.13: 「I will see to myself. Go wash your face.」
lines.14: 「We agreed that I would use the guest room on the first floor, yes?」
lines.15: Otome strode straight into the house.
lines.22: How had things suddenly come to this?
lines.23: Was this the Princess? Some prank dreamed up by a capricious Princess?
lines.24: 「I will be staying here until I graduate.」
lines.26: Staying... residing as a guest for some length of time.
lines.28: 「Did your parents not tell you? They were the ones who asked me to do this.」
lines.30: 「We seem to be trading nothing but questions.」
lines.31: 「They said you were hopelessly unreliable and asked me to whip you into shape.」
lines.33: 「I, too, felt you were in need of training. That is why I came.」
lines.35: Otome fixed me with a serious look.
lines.36: 「You should not dismiss your own welfare as 'just that.'」
lines.37: 「Ordinarily, it would be quicker for you to come to the Kurogane household. Grandfather is there as well.」
lines.38: 「But my family home is in Tokyo. That is far too distant a commute.」
lines.39: 「In fact, I used to leave early and change trains several times to reach school, but living so far away was inconvenient.」
lines.40: 「From here, it is a ten-minute walk. I gain more free time, and you do not have to move.」
lines.41: 「There is no rent, either. Frankly, I thought it a sound arrangement.」
lines.42: 「Will you study for your entrance exams here too?」
lines.43: 「I intend to earn a recommendation. My grades are no concern.」
lines.44: 「If anything, living closer lets me devote more effort to the disciplinary committee and my club. That suits a recommendation candidate perfectly.」
lines.45: 「Won't living with a guy look bad for someone seeking a recommendation?」
lines.46: 「If you and I were complete strangers, it would indeed be a serious problem. But what issue could there be between relatives?」
lines.49: 「...What? Do you dislike having me here?」
lines.50: 「N-No, I just mean, you know, a man and a woman under the same roof...」
lines.51: 「I am on the first floor, and you are on the second. It should hardly trouble us.」
